notes: The example screen's floating button now says Start with my numbers, so the way to your own plan follows you down the page instead of offering to log a payment on the sample debts.

Opened DebtFree from a link inside Instagram, Facebook or TikTok? You can now look around the example first. The tip about opening it in your browser appears when you start with your own numbers, which is when it matters.
The example screen no longer asks you to set due dates on the sample accounts.
